However, it only supports certain versions of Linux distributions and may not provide the same level of performance as native VMs.
In general, if you need more advanced virtualization capabilities and want to take advantage of the latest Linux features, Hyper-V may be a better choice. If you prefer a simpler setup and do not require advanced virtualization features, WSL2 may be a better option.
